root_cause.text: In rxrpc_input_packet_on_conn(), the client-side implicit-end error path unconditionally calls rxrpc_put_call() on a call pointer that may be NULL (because the call was already torn down and rxrpc_try_get_call() returned NULL), causing a reference count underflow or crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (call)` before `rxrpc_put_call(call, rxrpc_call_put_input);` in the error path (net/rxrpc/io_thread.c), and the commit message explains that when chan->call is NULL, rxrpc_try_get_call() returns NULL and there is no reference to drop, turning a protocol error into a kernel crash.
